C1043.title: BYOD Security Issues and Mitigation Strategies in Hospital Environments
C1043.summary: The study notes that 24% of data breaches in Australia during 2017–2018 were linked to BYOD. In healthcare settings, BYOD can lead to personal health information leaks, resulting in regulatory violations. The research examines security problems and mitigation strategies associated with BYOD in hospital environments.
